consumer: The frontend tile/sidebar renderer reading a per-monster threat color, asking 'what color does the GUI paint this visible monster by threat?' — a value computed purely to drive what is drawn, consumed by no engine condition/mission/dialogue check.
scope: Only monsters the avatar currently sees (a Creature::sees-gated visible set); the color is a formatted/bucketed view, not a map region or inventory reach.
decisive_source: NOT SHOWN: the GUI's threat-to-color routine (the monster danger-rating/attitude-to-color mapping the sidebar/map draw uses) is absent; Excerpt 3 src/creature.cpp::Creature::sees only computes the visible gate (range/light/LOS/concealment), and Excerpts 1-2 write raw hp scalars, none of which is the color authority.
divergence: A monster whose raw danger differs from its displayed tint — e.g. the GUI clamps or buckets danger into a threat color (or shades by attitude) so a re-derivation from raw difficulty paints a different color than the engine would draw; also a monster the avatar cannot see being tinted at all.
